capabilities: index attachments by creating sidecar notes with YAML metadata
extract title, author, and keywords from PDF files locally
enrich metadata via CrossRef DOI and OpenLibrary ISBN lookups
rename or delete sidecar notes when attachments change
backfill sidecar notes for pre-existing files
extras: The online DOI/ISBN lookup is off by default and needs no API key; auto-extracted metadata is flagged with a _heuristic: true property for human review. Requires Obsidian 1.7.0 or later; works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian's drag-and-drop attachment workflow gives no way to annotate files with metadata like title, author, or status that survives renaming or moving them.

relations.evidence: Obsidian Bases integration — automatically creates an Attachments Library.base file so you can browse
optionally enriches metadata by querying CrossRef (DOI)
and OpenLibrary (ISBN). No API key required.

summary: Creates a metadata sidecar note for each file in the Attachments folder, with local PDF extraction, DOI/ISBN lookup, and a Bases table view.
